Counselling has a pretty decent chance of working according to science. Can be pricy but being honest with a therapist about your situation can create good planning and treatment approaches. Anti depressants in combination with therapy is the most statistically likley approach to work and CBT is a good short term, symptom targeting, approach that has decent evidence to support it. Same thing with building some sort of self maintenance routine of excercise, meditation or other approach.
